_note: Per-category prompt pieces. The category of a photo is decided by how tall the head-and-neck mask is relative to the photo (umbral_cara = mask height / photo height; the first category, in orden, whose threshold is met wins). Any field left out falls back to the built-in default, so an empty category changes nothing. 'encuadre' is appended to the generation prompt of a custom shoot; the 'enhance_*' fields drive Enhance face.

closeup.label: Close-up
closeup.encuadre: Close-up portrait, the head and shoulders filling the frame.
closeup.enhance_extra: This is a close-up: the face is already large, so refine rather than rebuild -- pores, fine lines, eyelashes, iris detail and individual hair strands, without changing the shape of any feature.

half.label: Half body
half.enhance_extra: This is a waist-up shot: bring the face to full portrait detail and make sure the eyes, nose and mouth are unmistakably the person in <image2>.

full.label: Full body
full.encuadre: Full-length shot, the whole body visible from head to feet.
full.enhance_extra: This is a full-length shot and the face is small: rebuild it from <image2> so the identity reads at this size, keeping its size in the frame, the head angle and the hairline exactly.
